1. Start
2. Check Pressure Below -4cm
3. Check Pressure Above 60
4. Measure PEEP
5. Measure Pressure Parameters
6. Trigger Inspiration Cycle
7. Trigger Expiration Cycle
8. Meet PIP Targets
9. Meet Breath Rate
10. End

Transitions:
- From Start to Check Pressure Below -4cm (guard: pressure < -4cm)
- From Check Pressure Below -4cm to Measure PEEP (guard: pressure >= -4cm)
- From Measure PEEP to Check Pressure Above 60 (guard: pressure <= 60)
- From Check Pressure Above 60 to Measure Pressure Parameters (guard: pressure <= 60)
- From Measure Pressure Parameters to Trigger Inspiration Cycle (guard: PIP target within range)
- From Trigger Inspiration Cycle to Meet PIP Targets (guard: PIP target within range)
- From Meet PIP Targets to Meet Breath Rate (guard: breath rate within range)
- From Meet Breath Rate to Trigger Expiration Cycle (guard: breath rate within range)
- From Trigger Expiration Cycle to Meet Pressure Parameters (guard: pressure >= -4cm)
- From Meet Pressure Parameters to End (guard: pressure >= -4cm and <= 60)

States:
- Start
- Check Pressure Below -4cm
- Measure PEEP
- Check Pressure Above 60
- Measure Pressure Parameters
- Trigger Inspiration Cycle
- Meet PIP Targets
- Meet Breath Rate
- Trigger Expiration Cycle
- End
